storyNotes.originalText: Job was a GODLY man who did what was right. God blessed him with many things.
storyNotes.cleanText: Job was a godly man who did what was right. God blessed him with many things.

storyNotes.originalText: Satan told God, "If you take away Job's blessings, he'll CURSE you!"
storyNotes.cleanText: Satan told God, "If you take away Job's blessings, he'll curse you!"

storyNotes.originalText: Satan took away all his animals, servants, and CHILDREN. But Job did not curse God.
storyNotes.cleanText: Satan took away all his animals, servants, and children. But Job did not curse God.

storyNotes.originalText: Satan covered Job with SORES. But Job still would not curse God.
storyNotes.cleanText: Satan covered Job with sores. But Job still would not curse God.

storyNotes.originalText: Three of Job’s FRIENDS came to comfort him. They said, “You are suffering because of sin.”
storyNotes.cleanText: Three of Job’s friends came to comfort him. They said, “You are suffering because of sin.”

storyNotes.originalText: God asked Job and his friends many QUESTIONS to show that he was God and they were not.
storyNotes.cleanText: God asked Job and his friends many questions to show that he was God and they were not.

storyNotes.originalText: God blessed Job TWICE as much in the second part of his life.
storyNotes.cleanText: God blessed Job twice as much in the second part of his life.

questions.question: So why are we reading a book from the middle of the Bible?
questions.answer: Because Job most likely lived around the time of Abraham, though they probably never even met.

questions.question: What does the book of Job say about him?
questions.answer: He had respect for God and avoided evil.

questions.question: What kinds of animals did the Bible mention?
questions.answer: Sheep, camels, donkeys, and oxen.

questions.question: How many kids did Job have?
questions.answer: Seven sons and three daughters.

questions.question: Did you catch his name?
questions.answer: Satan.

questions.question: What did God say to Satan’s challenge?
questions.answer: Go ahead, but you can't touch Job himself.

questions.question: Did Job do what Satan said he would? Did he curse God and speak evil things right to God's face?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: What was the second challenge he made to God?
questions.answer: Strike Job’s body, he’ll curse you.

questions.question: But Satan was not allowed to… what?
questions.answer: Take Job's life.

questions.question: How?
questions.answer: Covered his body with sores.

questions.question: What?
questions.answer: Curse God and die!

questions.question: So did Satan succeed? Did Job curse God to his face?
questions.answer: No.

questions.question: What was the real cause of Job's misery?
questions.answer: Satan's deal with God.

questions.question: What was the point of God's windstorm of words?
questions.answer: To remind Job and his friends who was in control of the world.
questions.notes: The source answers the question in the following paragraph; answer is extracted faithfully from paragraph 127.

questions.question: What was it?
questions.answer: He was angry; they spoke foolishly.

questions.question: Who really caused Job’s suffering?
questions.answer: Satan.

questions.question: How many?
questions.answer: Seven sons and three daughters.

questions.question: So how does the story of Job teach us, strengthen us, encourage us, or give us hope?
questions.notes: Open discussion prompt; lesson continues into the Important Idea.

questions.question: What do we learn about Job at the beginning of the story?
questions.answer: He was a godly man; God greatly blessed him.

questions.question: Describe the first conversation Satan had with God.
questions.answer: Satan said Job would curse God if he lost all his blessings; God agreed to let Satan do this, but not to harm Job.

questions.question: How many messengers came to Job? What did they tell him?
questions.answer: Four; one after the other, they told him how his servants, animals, and children had died; they were all the only ones to escape.

questions.question: Talk about Job’s animals at the beginning, middle, and end of the story.
questions.answer: He had thousands. Because of Satan, they were all stolen or killed, in the end, God gave him double.

questions.question: Talk about what happened with Job’s servants at the beginning, middle, and end of the story.
questions.answer: He had many, they were killed, God gave him more.

questions.question: Talk about Job’s children at the beginning, middle, and end of the story.
questions.answer: He had ten children, they died when their house collapsed, God gave Job ten more children.

questions.question: Describe the second conversation Satan had with God.
questions.answer: Satan said Job would curse God if his body was harmed; God agreed to let Satan do this, but not to kill Job.

questions.question: What did Satan do to Job’s body?
questions.answer: Covered him head to toe with sores.

questions.question: What did Job’s wife say to him? Why did she say it?
questions.answer: Curse God and die; she saw how miserable he was.

questions.question: According to Job’s three friends, why was Job suffering?
questions.answer: He suffered because of his sin.

questions.question: What did God do when he talked to Job and his friends? Why?
questions.answer: He asked many questions to show that he was God and they were not.

questions.question: Who is the only one who knows the whole story of history? How does God’s great story end?
questions.answer: God; those who believe in Jesus will live forever in God’s kingdom.

questions.question: What was Job like?
questions.answer: A godly man who did what God said was right

questions.question: What is the first thing Satan said to God?
questions.answer: “If you take away your blessing from Job, he’ll curse you!”

questions.question: What happened to Job’s children, animals, and servants?
questions.answer: All of them were stolen or killed

questions.question: After losing his children, animals, and servants, did Job curse God?
questions.answer: No

questions.question: What is the second thing Satan said to God?
questions.answer: “Take away Job’s health and he’ll curse you.”

questions.question: What did Satan do to Job’s body? Did Job curse God?
questions.answer: Covered him with sores; he did not curse God

questions.question: What did Job’s wife tell him to do?
questions.answer: Curse God and die

questions.question: What did Job’s friends say to him?
questions.answer: You are suffering because of sin

questions.question: Why did God come and ask Job and his friends so many questions?
questions.answer: To show them he was God and they were not

questions.question: What happened at the end of Job’s life?
questions.answer: God blessed him with servants, twice as many animals, and ten more children
